name: Eritrean Railway (Asmara to Massawa line)
subtitle: A narrow-gauge line built under Italian rule that climbs from the Red Sea coast to the highland capital.

parts.text: A narrow-gauge line built under Italian rule that climbs from the Red Sea coast to the highland capital. It was damaged and abandoned in the 1970s war years and rehabilitated after independence by veteran railway workers; the line as a whole runs outside the inscribed perimeter, station location not verified.
